video_title: Toronto Raptors Full Media Availability | Practice | October 19, 2026

quotes.speaker: Kawhi Leonard
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard on the team's expectations for the new season
quotes.excerpt: It's the start of the year, we're not sure what to expect yet.
quotes.quote: It's the start of the year, we're not sure what to expect yet. We've been working hard during the whole training camp and we'll just see it down the road once 20, 25 games are under our belts and then we got to push from there and see what we need to do better.
quotes.social_post: Kawhi Leonard says the Raptors will need about 20 to 25 games to see what the team is capable of this season. He noted that the group is still working hard and figuring out their identity during training camp.

quotes.speaker: Kawhi Leonard
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard on managing his body and recovery
quotes.excerpt: Can't go as hard as you used to obviously, you got to be more smarter about everything.
quotes.quote: Can't go as hard as you used to obviously, you got to be more smarter about everything and recovery. You're not 20 years old no more, so that recovery is big. These are things you learn as years go on and you get these games under your belt.
quotes.social_post: Kawhi Leonard on his approach to the new season: You cannot go as hard as you used to. He emphasized that recovery is big and that he has to be smarter about everything as he gets older.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard on the recovery of Kelly Olynyk
quotes.excerpt: God bless him, hope he stays strong and just keep grinding.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Someone who knows what it takes to come back to get on the court from an injury, what does it take to be defensive and stay healthy out of the season with an injury?

text_blocks.speaker: Kawhi Leonard
text_blocks.text: It's good for him. I think he had a rough year last year. I don't know if he got his body together. You're saying he's not playing this year? Oh, I didn't know that. Oh, damn, that's sad. You just, he has another year, he's still in his young 30s I believe, or not 30 yet, I'm not sure, but God bless him, hope he stays strong and just keep grinding. If he locks in in this 2026, he could be able to come back from Kelly's injury.

quotes.social_post: Kawhi Leonard reacts to the news regarding Kelly Olynyk and his injury status, offering well wishes to his teammate as he continues his recovery process.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajaković on his excitement for the start of the season
quotes.excerpt: The moment I start feeling butterflies and excitement, I'm going to stop doing this job.
quotes.quote: The moment I start feeling butterflies and excitement, I'm going to stop doing this job. I am super pumped up for the start of the year, but until the start of the year we still have one practice and one shoot around, so there is a lot of work to be done before that.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic says he is super pumped for the start of the season but remains focused on the work left to do in practice and shootaround before the opener.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajaković on helping rookies adjust to the game's speed
quotes.excerpt: They need to slow down in order to understand what's going on around them.
quotes.quote: It's always like when players come, the first thing that they need to adjust is the speed of the game. For them at the beginning, the game is happening at such a high speed and they need to slow down in order to understand what's going on around them. I think the most important thing is for players, for media, for everybody to understand that it's a process. It's not something that we're going to throw him out there and he's going to have all the answers.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic says the biggest adjustment for rookies is the speed of the game. He noted that it is a process and fans should not expect them to have all the answers immediately.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajaković on the development of Gradey Dick
quotes.excerpt: All the drives, all the finishes, going to the rim, getting fouled and ones, that's something that really stood out.
quotes.quote: I thought he did great. He played heavy minutes this last game. I was just talking to him and all the drives, all the finishes, going to the rim, getting fouled and ones, like that that's something that really stood out and he's got to continue doing that. We need him to to be a beast rebounding the ball offensively and defensively.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic praised Gradey Dick for his recent play, specifically his ability to get to the rim and draw fouls. He added that the team needs Dick to be a beast on the boards this season.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajaković on Kawhi Leonard's veteran presence
quotes.excerpt: Guys have a lot of respect for him, they they have a great communication, they pick up his brain.
quotes.quote: It's his veteran presence. Guys have a lot of respect for him, they they have a great communication, they pick up his brain, ask a lot of things. He's been great with the coaches. It's adjustment for him as well, it's a new team, new teammates, new coaches. So I think all of this is a great learning period for us and the more time we spend around each other and with each other and playing, it's going to help us gel much better.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic says Kawhi Leonard has been great with the coaching staff and teammates during his adjustment to a new team, noting the veteran presence he brings to the locker room.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajaković on Scottie Barnes' scoring development
quotes.excerpt: I think that he elevated his game a lot. I think it's going to help us in our whole team.
quotes.quote: Scottie, he he's been put a lot of work over the course of summer. I think that he elevated his game a lot. I think it's going to help us in our whole team. We need Scottie to be himself, we need Scottie to be a beast getting to the rim, scoring at the rim. We need Scottie also to knock down his threes and we need Scottie also one time and place in the right moment is to post up and to to take his mid-range shots.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic says Scottie Barnes has elevated his game this summer. The coach wants Barnes to be a beast at the rim while also knocking down threes and utilizing his mid-range game.
